item.author: member@example.com (member15)
item.dc:creator: member15
item.content:encoded:
One SEO metric I think deserves more attention: the percentage of published URLs that get at least one organic click over a set period.
Most dashboards focus on total indexed pages, impressions and clicks. Useful, but they can hide a growing tail of pages that never attract real search demand. A site can publish thousands of new URLs while nearly all traffic still comes from a small group of older pages.
I like looking at it by cohort: group pages by publication month and template, then...

item.title: Tips for building a B2B contact list for outreach in India
item.author: member@example.com (member27)
item.dc:creator: member27
item.content:encoded:
Sharing a short checklist we use when building B2B contact lists for outreach in India:

1. Define the ideal customer first: industry, city, company size.
2. Target designations, not generic inboxes: founders, directors, heads of sales/HR/procurement.
3. Segment the list and write a different first message per segment.
4. Keep data fresh, since people change roles often.
5. Respect opt-outs and India's DND rules for calls and SMS.
6. Track reply and meeting rates per segment and drop what...
